services.name: Seaside Tour
services.desc: Witness the charm of this small coastal town from the skies. Our luxury helicopter tours offer a unique and unforgettable perspective of Seaside like never before. See iconic landmarks and stunning views, making your visit truly memorable. $99 Per

gap: Duration for most tours is not stated
blurb: Fly Seaside offers luxury helicopter tours showcasing iconic landmarks and stunning views of the Oregon Coast, including Seaside, Cannon Beach, Tillamook Lighthouse, Cape Falcon, and more. Tours range from short 3-minute experiences to all-inclusive 120-mile coastal journeys. The company also provides helicopter support services for photo/video shoots and surveys.

quotes.author: Matt Clarkson
quotes.text: This really made our visit to seaside complete. I was a little hesitant at first, but our pilot Rafa made us feel so comfortable, and Gabe was great for ground support. The view up there was incredible! Haystack Rock, the lighthouse, and the surrounding mountains. I can't wait to do it again!

quotes.author: Fabio Gutierrez
quotes.text: First Ever Helicopter Ride. I really recommend this place to anyone that wants to experience a helicopter tour. The staff was really welcoming and friendly. Will definitely be coming back.

quotes.author: sukhjit singh
quotes.text: Gabe and Rafael are really nice and perfect guide. i loved the ride . Rafael took us to cannon beach, lighthouse and sea side . view from helicopter was totally worth it.

quotes.author: Debbie Cornes
quotes.text: Had a wonderful Mother's Day experience with my son. Very professional and experienced. I would highly recommend for a unique adventure. Life's too short!
